subject.title: fix(agents): bound models.json catalog file read with size limit

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally reject existing valid root `models.json` catalogs larger than 1 MiB during registry initialization?
rationale: This is both a resource-safety boundary and a breaking change to a persisted user configuration file; the repository policy treats new fail-closed validation and new operator action as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Add an upgrade-compatible policy
options.body: Define a supported path for existing large catalogs and test both the bounded safety behavior and upgrade behavior before merging.

options.title: Approve the hard fail-closed limit
options.body: Treat catalogs above 1 MiB as unsupported existing configuration and document the resulting required user action before merge.

recommendation.title: Add an upgrade-compatible policy
recommendation.body: Define a supported path for existing large catalogs and test both the bounded safety behavior and upgrade behavior before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available low-confidence routing candidate for model-catalog behavior.
